snippet.title: Bubsy 4D - Black Hole Update - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The bobcat is back! Blast into the Black Hole Content Update—a massive, free update  featuring 15 brand-new levels, new hazards and challenges, a fresh set of costumes and unlocks, and much more. The FREE update is available now - Go get it! 

Play it today!
